title: Kinda Chic Trend
claim: The trend began around April 2026 and exploded in August 2026 with high-engagement creator and celebrity posts.
excerpt: Search summary: early example by Instagram user mariabegins on April 27, 2026; Aug 2 TikTok by @lifewitht00 ('feels kind of chic to be chubby...') 192,000+ likes in five days; Aug 3 Drew Barrymore carousel 170,000+ likes in four days; summaries also cite Google searches up 5,000% and hashtag counts of 60,000 to 97,000 posts (source page within results not identified).
